questions.question: The man ___ lives next door is a doctor.

questions.question: The book ___ I bought is interesting.

questions.question: The woman ___ car was stolen called the police.

questions.question: ประโยคใดถูกต้อง
choices: The pen who I lost was blue.
The pen that I lost was blue.
The pen whose I lost was blue.
The pen where I lost was blue.
questions.explanation: that ใช้แทนสิ่งของได้

questions.question: รวมประโยค "I met a man. His brother is a pilot." ได้ถูกต้อง
choices: I met a man who his brother is a pilot.
I met a man which brother is a pilot.
I met a man whose brother is a pilot.
I met a man whom brother is a pilot.
